summary: I read all eleven pages and, for each of the 30 links, the target or the passages in it that name the source, plus the SUBSTRATE and Modes Context companions and the SUBSTRATE anatomy JSON. Pattern: the Trickster, Generative Compression and Palace Enchantment links mostly had a reason sitting in a body section that merely wanted a label (16 labels); the unsaid links were nearly all genuinely empty (12 cuts); two are really another type (Palace Enchantment spawned Threshold Conatus; SUBSTRATE emerged from Songlines, per its Context). No keep-as-is, since none of the 30 had a label. Several cuts are pair-folds, not lost ideas: SUBSTRATE and Palace Enchantment, Flow Field and flow-field-spine, Trickster and Dialogue Moderator, Trickster and Palace Enchantment each carry two edges. I proposed no new inbound links to the newcomer list, since none of my pages gave a genuine one. Not settled: SUBSTRATE -> Lateral Access and Modes -> Symbiotic Skills have only a diagram membership and an open question behind them (cut, medium confidence); I read Palace Enchantment by section and target passage, not all 1,060 lines; and the labels are my wording, not checked against the vocabulary in use beyond Resonant Link Labels.
